name: Buon Ma Thuot
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025 the province merged with Phu Yen. The coast is now in the same province on paper, but Buon Ma Thuot remains a highland coffee city, not a beach stop.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Buon Ma Thuot is the robusta capital of the central highlands: phin coffee in the morning, museums and coffee houses in town, and red-bowl bun do on Le Hong Phong after 16:00. Fly into BMV from Ho Chi Minh City in about an hour. Three sights have licensed photos today — Dray Nur waterfall, Khai Doan pagoda, and the prison heritage site — while Lak Lake, Yok Don, and the coffee museums stay in the dossier until photos arrive.
fee: Museums and waterfalls each ticket separately
getThere: Buon Ma Thuot Airport (BMV), then taxi to downtown
seoTitle: Buon Ma Thuot travel guide — coffee and bun do
seoDescription: Two days in Vietnam’s coffee capital: BMV airport, Dray Nur, Khai Doan pagoda, and bun do afternoons. Other sights stay dossier-only until licensed photos land.
intro: You wake to the smell of robusta, not sea salt. Buon Ma Thuot sits on the red-soil plateau of Dak Lak, and the day starts with a phin drip before you cross town to Nguyen Dinh Chieu for the World Coffee Museum or Y Ngong for the Dak Lak Museum and Bao Dai Palace. Those indoor stops are named in the dossier but do not have attraction pages yet because no licensed sight photo passed review. Sleep here if coffee culture and ethnic museums are the trip. Fly on to Nha Trang or Da Lat if the beach or pine hills matter more.

Afternoons belong to bun do on Le Hong Phong — also dossier-only on the food side until a dish photo exists. Published attraction cards today are Dray Nur waterfall, Khai Doan pagoda, and the prison on Tan Thuat. Save Yok Don’s elephant forest walk and Lak Lake for when you have a car; they stay off the public list for the same photo rule. The biennial coffee festival fills October 10 Square in March; the ninth edition ran 9–13 March 2025, and the next year is check on arrival.
gettingAround: Buon Ma Thuot Airport is in Hoa Thang Commune, southeast of the center. Airlines serve Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Da Nang, and other domestic hubs; drive time to downtown is check on arrival. Grab and taxis work in town. Dray Nur is about 25 to 30 km south by road; Lak Lake, Yok Don, and Ea Kao need a hired car or tour. Minutes are not printed on the sources used here.

eat: Bun do in the afternoon, com lam with grilled chicken on village day trips, and phin coffee any time. No public food guide or dish pages until licensed dish photos exist; names stay in the dossier.

faqs.q: Is Buon Ma Thuot a beach trip after the Phu Yen merger?
faqs.a: No. The province now includes Phu Yen’s coast on paper, but Buon Ma Thuot is inland on the coffee plateau. Plan the beach from Tuy Hoa or Nha Trang as its own leg.

faqs.q: Why are the coffee museum and bun do not on the site yet?
faqs.a: Attraction and dish pages need a licensed photo of that sight or bowl. Dray Nur, Khai Doan pagoda, and the prison passed that bar. The dossier still lists the museum, Lak Lake, Yok Don, and bun do for planning.
The ninth festival ran 9–13 March 2025 with ceremonies on October 10 Square. Provincial approval text says the event is held every two years. Later dates are check on arrival.
